description: We are a team that likes researching and coding.
summary: This project is about how fire behaves in space. On Earth, flames are yellow or orange and have a teardrop shape. Howeveri in space, flames become round and blue
details:
The dashboard we created analyzes data about the behaviour of flames in microgravity and converts it into graphs that everyone can understand easily. It shows the differences between flames on Earth and in space, such as their shape, colour and burning speed. We used Python and Streamlit to develop our dashboard. We also used Google AI to collect information and support our research.

 

Our project makes it easier to understand how flames behave in a microgravity environment. It helps people learn scientific information in a simple and visual way. Our project is creative because it combines science, technology and data visualization. While developing it, we considered the accuracy of the information, the clarity of the graphs and the ease of use. Our aim is to make learning about fire in space more interesting and understandable for everyone.
dataRefs: Why NASA is studying flames in space
